# Keep supporting details separate for repeated employers or schools

## What & Why
Resume entries with the same employer or institution name can still be ambiguous when their supporting bullets or details are restored. A regression here protects reviewers from one repeated-name entry inheriting another entry's provenance.

## Done looks like
- A synthetic resume can contain repeated employer and institution names with different supporting details.
- Accepting or editing either entry preserves the correct bullets, details, and provenance.
- Rejected repeated-name entries add no structured data.
